items.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004
items.q: And they had two boys and I got Béla, which is not a bad situation considering my brother got Ludwig.

ctx.x: I don’t know. I don’t think so. But my father, who — it’s a complicated story, I won’t go into too much except that I only got to meet him and get to know him over the last few years, they split up when I was really young and he named me. They had a deal, if it was

a boy he would name us, and if it was a girl, my mother would name it. It was a strange arrangement they had. And they had two boys and I got Béla, which is not a bad situation considering my brother got Ludwig.
